title: usage counts kept in our own database, nothing leaving the platform

criteria.text: Coming back: members active each week, by the week they joined, for the last 12 weeks
criteria.note: Count tables and handler (#1268) [V]. Checked: `[guards F133.1]` in `tests/usage-counts-db.test.ts`.

criteria.text: What they use: per day, members who used each part of the app, once per member per part per day
Where they drop off: per week, how many reached each sign-up step, a first follow and a first post
Counts only: no member id, email, IP or precise location beside any count; dedupe keys are one-way hashes deleted within 8 days
Nothing leaves: no usage data goes to an outside service; nothing added to a page load
criteria.note: Built in #1268 [V]. Checked: standing guard `[guards F133.5]` in `src/lib/usage/count-use.test.ts` (no client file reaches the counting code, which calls nothing outside).

criteria.text: One switch: a member who turned sharing off on You is never counted; builders are never counted
criteria.note: Uses the existing search and map-tap switch (#1268) [V]. Checked: `[guards F133.6]` in `tests/usage-counts-db.test.ts`.

criteria.text: On the dashboard: staff see the three answers; nobody else can read the counts
criteria.note: Built in #1268 [V]. Checked: `[guards F133.7]` in `tests/usage-counts-db.test.ts`; the dashboard itself is slated for retirement (F131.8).

criteria.text: Counting starts before the first invited cohort arrives
criteria.note: Timing: #1268 PR body 'merge and apply before the first cohort'. Merged 2026-11-12; no source read today shows the migration applied in production or the cohort date [A].
